summary: GMEX Robotics Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing a 1-for-9 share consolidation of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective July 2, 2026. The consolidation, approved by the board without shareholder vote, reduces outstanding Class A shares from 8.1M to ~904k and Class B shares from ~7.2k to 799. The company states this is a capital structure optimization to align market profile with operational progress. This is a routine corporate action (reverse stock split), not a special situation, and is often used to meet listing standards. No premium, consideration, or deal mechanics apply.
